constraints: Cannot be used with fields in the List form of a subform.
Text can be highlighted either by the user or by the HIGHLIGHT TEXT command.

overloadMerges.note: startSel and endSel are filled in by the command (out), not in parameters.

params.description: If passed, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a field or variable reference

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * passed) or field/variable reference (if * omitted)

params.name: startSel
params.description: Position of the first highlighted character

params.name: endSel
params.description: Position of the last highlighted character

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns, in startSel and endSel, the currently highlighted text range within object.
